sentence: This project studies how adult stem cells in Drosophila use DNA replication to make daughter cells with different epigenetic fates.
This project builds machine learning models that use health record data to predict which autistic children face persistent adverse mental health outcomes.
This project uses DNA memory devices and 3D cell culture models of the developing human brain to record the signals that guide brain development.
This project builds a smartphone-based tool that helps diagnose ear infections in rural children during virtual telehealth consultations.
This project tries to find out the genetic basis of drug resistance and of recovery after exposure to a drug.
This project checks whether systematic reviews of drugs report safety information in a consistent way and in line with drug labels.
This project tries to make radioimmunotherapy for acute myeloid leukemia work better and more safely by using antibodies to deliver highly potent radioisotopes.
This project uses deep mutational scanning to test how mutations in the spikes of coronaviruses affect cell entry and how well vaccine antibodies bind them.
This project offers bioinformatics and computational biology services, and tools for managing and sharing big data, to support cancer research studies.
This project studies the mechanisms that regulate energy homeostasis and nutrient metabolism and how they relate to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.
This project builds a robotic system for spinal decompression and interbody fusion in minimally invasive spine surgery.
This project studies how handling of cerebrospinal fluid samples affects mass spectrometry measurements of immune proteins in pediatric brain tumor patients.
This project builds a ceramide analog drug that selectively induces lethal mitophagy to inhibit tumor growth in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project tests a therapeutic Zika virus as a treatment for glioblastoma, checking its safety and efficacy.
This project builds network-based tools that use magnetic resonance imaging and intracranial recordings to help choose patients for epilepsy surgery and find surgical targets.
This project builds a computer tool that analyzes exercise stress electrocardiography to give the statistical likelihood of coronary artery disease.
This project studies how combinations of transcription factors reprogram endothelial cells into hematopoietic stem cells.
This project builds genetically engineered cell culture and animal models to study aberrant interferon-mediated inflammation and myeloid-biased hematopoiesis in a severe autoinflammatory syndrome.
This project expands an analytical laboratory and builds a tissue culture lab and a microscopy room with a confocal microscope that images live cells.
This project studies how a pathway on tumor vasculature limits immune cells from getting into melanoma.
